tweets.text:
WHAT IS TOMOCHI? (long read but worth it)

Most of you weren't familiar with me or Tomochi (fka Poki) until recently, so here's a detailed breakdown of everything you should know:

Tomochi is the name of our brand but it's also the name of the world in which Poki and his friends live. The goal of Tomochi is to become an IP Titan. We want Tomochi characters to be everywhere a few years from now. Think Chiikawa, SanRio, etc...this is the market we're going for.

Through Tomochi we want to spread joy, love and good vibes.

We have been taking the time over the past 18 months to lay the foundation of the brand. We've been posting everyday on all platforms (organically) and the growth has been exponential. The brand was named Poki at first and was only centered around our Poki character, but quickly, a whole world started growing around him (Mototo, Luna, Roz, etc...): characters with their own stories, vibes, and their own little corners of this universe.

So we decided it was time to give that world a name. Which is when we introduced Tomochi (Poki & Friends is a registered company and we own the Tomochi trademark).

SOME HISTORY ABOUT THE COIN

In January 2025, @jessicakomori, @Toricenn and I created Poki, a cute hamster inspired character. From the beginning the goal was to turn this cutie into a mainstream IP. 

We launched $poki on pumpfun on february 2025, as we believed it would be easier to grow a new IP from scratch by leveraging the exposure and holder base of the coin. Later that year, we migrated to BonkFun (we were an OG pump pair so we weren't earning fees and at the time it was impossible to migrate to pumpswap).

We stayed on Bonkfun for about 10 months and ended up deciding to migrate back to @Pumpfun to earn more fees and increase our runway + we didn't like some of the things going on at bonk at the time. (side note: in 15 days on Pump we have earned over $10k in fees, vs 1.33M POKI (name of the former token) + 1.565 SOL in fees in 10 months on Bonkfun). 

The brand evolved and we didn't want our holders to feel like they were getting left behind which is why we took advantage of the migration to change the ticker from Poki to Tomochi.

TOMOCHI NUMBERS

While barely anyone knows about Tomochi in crypto yet, the brand is growing fast, here are a few numbers:

- We have 5000+ Tomochi memes/artworks
- 80k followers on Instagram
- 31k followers on Facebook
- 23k followers on TikTok
- 2B+ total views across all socials (TT/IG/FB/Giphy/Tenor, etc...)

We're very grateful to have a community of patient people who share our vision and know what we're trying to do takes time. The same holders showed up literally everyday for the past 8 months, whether the coin was at 500k, 50k or even now above 1M. Die hard Tomochi supporters.

BE THE CHANGE YOU WANT TO SEE

I've been in the space for a long time and it is extremely frustrating to see how most people have no patience these days. Average holding time has drastically decreased and people no longer want to believe in (due to multiple factors including bear market PTSD).

Good teams are left to die and serial deployers constantly farm you. Trust in the trenches has been broken and I believe in order to be restored, some people need to step up and lead by example. 

Nowadays when coins die, the devs usually just stop working on it and move on to something else.

But it doesn't have to be that way.

This is why we've been showing up every single day since launch with the same hunger, regardless of the market cap or price action. The team is resilient and the vision is clear.

We can't change the whole space, but we can at least try to do better in our small little corner fo the industry.

Not many of you know me but last year I hit rock bottom. I was financially down bad, going through some shit IRL and had literally almost no money left to build Tomochi. Realistically most people would have pulled the plug and called it quits.

Instead, I decided to move to my sister's house, slept on her couch for months to save money and use everything I had left to keep growing Tomochi and rebuild myself. Everything I do is for Tomochi.

I'm now in a much better spot and so is Tomochi. Blessed and grateful to be in that position.

The goal remains the same, it'll take a while but we will turn Tomochi into a multi billion dollar brand. We have always been a scrappy team with little ressources but we always found a way. I believe consistency is key.

If you read all that and want to support us/join the adventure by buying solana:6mJoQqcPEjiQ1hFya9oH6NBCQLhvS3mwVQWV9EcTHg9u, keep in mind that this is a long term play, this isn't something you flip over night. 

Buy Tomochi and sit on your hands for a very long time.

Do not expect me to tweet about it everyday, this isn't a hype play, I'll keep building my personal brand while simultaneously building Tomochi. That said, I have been buying more tomochi every time I hit a trade and I plan to keep doing so in the future.

Hopefully once tomochi succeeds it'll encourage good devs to keep building and people to start holding again.

Onward.

tweets.text:
Be the change you want to see and practice what you preach.

I'm a huge advocate of 2 things

1) Believing & Holding
I believe bundling coins at 5k to extract 20SOL at 25k is ruining the trenches (shocking ik) and I think we should collectively do our best to make people believe in holding again + stop giving a platform to farmers.

Which is why I publicly ran 2 figs to 7 figs by holding the same coin (cash-cat:native) for weeks (amongst other trades). I want to show that it's still doable. People have bear market ptsd and everytime they open this app they see people who take 50+ trades/day flex their PNLs.

You don't need to do that, you don't need to overtrade. Stop aping everything, understand how the trenches work, pick better coins and work for your bags. Stop selling everytime you see a mini red candle.

I've been preaching about holding for years & still do and that's why I hold good coins regardless of short term PA. I've roundtripped a lot but I've also hit generational trades.

2) Support good teams
I believe teams that stick around and actually show up everyday for months to build products/brands and do right by their holders deserve to win more than people who launch multiple coins/week.

At the moment, we mostly reward farmers and serial deployers (fartcoin dev, ansem dev, etc...). Good teams/projects are left to die because people aren't patient anymore. They want everything NOW, they want teams to work nonstop but they don't want to wait/support while the team lays the foundation.

If we want people to keep doing cool shit/come to the space to experiment, we need to change the mentality of the trenches.

Words don't matter and as I said above, you should always practice what you preach, which is why I spent the past 1.5 years working on the same coin, turning it into a brand outside of crypto and finding ways to keep going even when I lost everything late 2025. I believe by showing people there are still tenacious/relentless mfs out here who are willing to put the work in, people will start having faith in good teams again.

Last year I zeroed out + got drained hard and hit rock bottom, had barely any $ left to my name. Yet we still had monthly expenses to cover if we wanted to keep building the project. solana:6mJoQqcPEjiQ1hFya9oH6NBCQLhvS3mwVQWV9EcTHg9u was and remains my priority...so we found a way to make it happen and Tomochi is now growing faster than ever outside of crypto.

Now I'm in a better position, covered one full year of expenses in advance and I also buy more solana:6mJoQqcPEjiQ1hFya9oH6NBCQLhvS3mwVQWV9EcTHg9u every time I hit a good trade.

This is just an example but there are a lot of great overlooked teams out there who deserve support as well.

tweets.text:
I have been in crypto for 10 years (full time, 4 years) and I’ve never owned any stocks…until now.

As a crypto-native trader, @binance’s bStocks let me gain exposure to real equities through an interface and experience that feels familiar.

I’ve mostly been trading memes and majors all those years and it’s great to see Binance once again leading innovation by bridging the gap between crypto and TradFi.

Now if I’m honest, I probably would have not bought or heard about bStocks if it wasn’t for memes.

As you know, over the past few days we’ve seen the emergence of memecoins paired to stocks, paying out rewards in bStocks.

For example, I bought $marscoin last week (and I plan to hold for a while) which is paired to SPCX, because I liked the narrative. Turns out the coin pays out SPCXB (SpaceX bstocks) to holders and I’ve since earned ~$20k in Tesla stocks just for holding this coin.

Imo, this is the best way to bridge the gap between meme traders, traditional crypto, and TradFi. It also gives newer traders exposure to different asset classes, helping them build financial literacy naturally over time.

Great and fun tek!

bStocks have had a lot of volume over the past few weeks, there’s clear demand.

BSC/BNB season seems inevitable at this point @cz_binance

tweets.text:
In 2023 I sold 650k POPCAT for $15k, this would have been $1.2M at the top.

In 2024 I sold 800k PONKE for $8k, this would have been $700k at the top.

We have all sold too early/fumbled trades before but those 2 trades had ONE thing in common

Both coins were high conviction plays, yet I sold them to fomo into new hot pairs out of pure fomo/greed thinking I'd be able to make a quick flip and buy back even more

Needless to say I should have stuck to my high conviction plays.

Just wanted to share that because, as we enter the bull market you may be tempted to buy every shiny new coins because they're pumping...you might consider selling your long term conviction bags to feed this urge.

Don't. They're high conviction plays for a reason. You'll get burned playing the new pairs/musical chairs game.

99% of the time you'll outperform everyone by doing nothing. Just sit on your hands if you're holding good coins.

Overtrading is the #1 mistake you can make.

Good luck out there.
